note: Pin manifest for SparkInkling 0.4.1, recipe linux-nvidia-dgx-spark-inkling2-mini-atlas version 1: Inkling 2 Mini on one DGX Spark. The release adds image input, budget forcing for Inkling's reasoning loops (and low as the default reasoning effort), streamed tool-call arguments with the tool guard's stream setting, branch checkpoints in the prefix cache, and faster batched decode. Image built from Enntity/sparkinkling main at the pinned revision; its build ran 8,803 engine tests, and its RigMark release measurement and functional check are in that repository's results/2026-11-23-release-0.4.1. image.reference is the GHCR manifest digest; the tag is the first 12 characters of the install/ tree.
